transform_AgglomerationTransform: transform the AgglomerationTransform class to cluster features using pooling functions and return pooled values
inverse_transform_AgglomerationTransform: inverse_transform the AgglomerationTransform class to map clustered values back to original feature dimensions
review_AgglomerationTransform: review the AgglomerationTransform class for feature agglomeration via the transform interface
summarize_transform: summarize the transform method of AgglomerationTransform that pools feature values using clustering labels
summarize_inverse_transform: summarize the inverse_transform method of AgglomerationTransform that assigns cluster values back to original features
